Description

The NA Majors Casualty team is looking for an Actuary to provide support for one of Liberty Mutual's largest customers. In this role you will aid with profit, growth, and operational objectives for the account through pricing, evaluating & monitoring performance, supporting internal stakeholders, and providing consultative support to the customer. You will build a deep level of knowledge and expertise of the account to provide meaningful actuarial analyses around drivers of loss, impact of business strategy and other operational changes, macro effects, etc. Driving efficiency and improvement in approaches to pricing and tools to enable team to better understand the risk and support a strong client relationship are also requirements. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical and communication skills, as well as a demonstrated ability to execute thoroughly in a collaborative environment. In this role you will encounter a variety of responsibilities including collaboration with the customer, internal account team, Reserving, Data Science, Risk Control, Claims, Office of Underwriting, LOB pricing partners, and other subject matter experts. This position requires a highly organized, self-motivated individual with strong technical as well as verbal and written communication skills.

Ideal candidate will have experience with Workers Compensation, Auto Liability and General Liability

Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with the account team, providing pricing and other actuarial support aligned with profitability and growth goals.
  • Perform complex actuarial analyses to assist business decision making and strategy development.
  • Provide clear and concise communication of technical actuarial work to the account team, senior leadership, and the customer.
  • Enhance and execute large account pricing methods to supplement technical pricing for the account. Drive continuous improvement of processes.
  • Collaborate with Data Science team to influence current model accuracy and applicability as well as drive new innovative solutions.
  • Collaborate with Reserving teams to support and influence reserve deep dives.
  • Directly influence and engage in quarterly business reviews.
  • Support the financial planning process for the account.
  • Proactively identify training opportunities; create & deliver content accordingly.
  • Maintain clear and concise documentation of methods and activities.
  • Mentor, motivate, and train less experienced staff and peers.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
  • Associateship or Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS/FCAS) designation preferred or comparable education/designation with relevant experience.
  • Minimum 5-7 years relevant experience required.
  • Sound knowledge of actuarial techniques and standards, as well as other business operations including financial, underwriting, legal, statistics, claims, sales, etc.
  • Advanced communication and interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships and interact effectively with others within and outside the organization.
  • Ability to motivate and mentor peers and motivate and train subordinates.
  • Advanced computing skills (MS Office Excel, SAS, etc.) with ability to build complex models.
About Us

By actively seeking employee feedback and amplifying the voices of our seven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are open to all, we create an environment where every individual can make a meaningful impact so we continue to meet the evolving needs of our customers.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://LMI.co/Benefits

Job Description Summary
The Field Service Automation Deployment Lead is a recognized expert in robotics and automation responsible for shaping and directing GE Vernova's global automation strategy. Serving as a senior strategic lead, this role drives the modernization of maintenance practices for our global fleet of fielded equipment by defining and implementing enterprise-wide deployment policies. The successful candidate acts as the primary technical authority, bridging the gap between complex automation architectures and site-level execution to ensure solutions are robust, scalable, and compliant with rigorous performance, safety, and cybersecurity standards. By providing functional leadership to cross-functional teams and system integrators, this professional manages the end-to-end integration and commissioning lifecycle, exercising high-level judgment to resolve complex technical challenges and influence the long-term operational excellence of GE Vernova's automation ecosystem.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Define and implement global deployment standards and policies for field service automation, directly influencing the overarching maintenance strategy for GE Vernova's enterprise fleet.
  • Drive the concept development, build, integration, and commissioning activities for field service automation projects, ensuring delivery on time and within budget.
  • Lead and execute the development of project scope, schedules, deliverables, and integration requirements partnering with vendors, system integrators, internal technical teams, and GE Vernova business partners.
  • Manage all aspects of field service automation deployment, including installation, testing, validation, and transition to production, ensuring full compliance with safety and cyber standards.
  • Exercise independent, high-level judgment to resolve complex, multi-variable technical challenges where standard procedures may not yet exist, effectively balancing cost, speed, and safety in high-stakes environments.
  • Monitor project performance against KPIs, budgets, and milestones; proactively mitigate risks and resolve complex issues to ensure delivery excellence.
  • Establish and maintain documentation for project plans, technical specifications, commissioning checklists, and lessons learned.
  • Collaborate with technical authorities and stakeholders to ensure solutions are robust, scalable, and fit for purpose.
  • Support vendor management and performance oversight during the build and commissioning phases.
  • Drive continuous improvement by ensuring post-project reviews and sharing best practices for automation deployment.
  • Foster strong working relationships with stakeholders across engineering, operations, safety, cybersecurity, and IT/OT functions.
  • Provide functional leadership and mentorship to project-based teams and system integrators, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement across all deployment sites.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority for field service automation, providing specialized guidance to regional leads and business partners on feasibility, safety, and regulatory compliance.

Qualifications/Requirements:
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience building and deploying industrial automation solutions in complex, large-scale organizations.
  • Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of automation architectures, industrial safety standards, and cybersecurity protocols within heavy industry.
  • Judgment & Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence strategy, gain cross-functional buy-in, and provide expert technical consultation.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to interpret industry trends and translate complex business challenges into actionable, scalable technical solutions.
  • Communication: Superior ability to communicate difficult technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership and site-level teams.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to customer/site locations as required (Estimated: 20%).

Desired Characteristics:
  • Master's degree in Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in large-scale industrial automation.
  • Formal program/project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).
  • Demonstrated experience leading small-to-medium project teams in matrixed, multi-site environments.
  • Technical proficiency in Augmented Reality (AR), visual inspection, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT), and robotic platforms.
  • Hands-on field service maintenance experience in the energy, manufacturing, or heavy industry sectors.
  • A "continuous learner" mindset with a passion for driving innovation and operational excellence.

Vice President, Professional Services - United States

This role is Remote, United States, with a preference for candidates located on the West Coast or within 50 miles of a Cornerstone office

The mission

Cornerstone Services plays a critical role in helping customers realize value faster, and we are entering an exciting next phase in how we sell, deliver, and scale Services globally.

The Vice President, Professional Services will lead Cornerstone's global Services organization across Services Sales and Services Delivery. We are looking for a true builder and operator: someone who has successfully scaled a global Services organization, knows what strong operating fundamentals look like, and is energized by the opportunity to build what comes next rather than simply run an established model.

This leader will balance two mandates at once: strengthen the operating foundation required to perform consistently at global scale while transforming Services around faster time-to-value, better customer outcomes, partner scale, and AI-enabled delivery. They will connect regional teams around one global strategy while partnering deeply across Sales, Partners, Product, and the broader Customer Organization to shape the full customer journey.

This is an opportunity to lead a global business through a meaningful inflection point and help define what a modern, AI-enabled Services organization should look like.
In this role you will...

1. Operate one global Services organization

Set the global strategy and operating model across Services Sales and Delivery, creating the structure, rhythms, metrics, and accountability required to operate as one business across regions.

Bring together diverse regional perspectives while creating clarity on global priorities, decision rights, performance expectations, and ways of working. Build the fundamentals needed to scale while preserving the local market understanding required to serve customers effectively around the world.

Own Services performance across revenue, margin, utilization, capacity, delivery quality, customer experience, and time-to-value.

2. Accelerate customer value and experience

Make faster time-to-value and stronger customer outcomes central to how Services operates and measures success.

Build a delivery model that is simpler, more predictable, and easier for customers to navigate, reducing unnecessary complexity from sales through implementation and value realization.

Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Solutions, Support, and other Customer Organization leaders to improve the end-to-end customer journey, strengthen commitments made during the sales cycle, and resolve the cross-functional barriers that slow customer value.

3. Scale through a global delivery ecosystem

Build the right delivery ecosystem across Cornerstone teams, Global Delivery Centers, and strategic Services partners.

Define where Cornerstone should lead directly, where partners provide the best path to scale, and how teams work together to deliver a consistent customer experience. Strengthen partner readiness, governance, quality, and accountability as partner-led delivery grows.

Bring strong global operating judgment, including experience navigating different regional business environments, workforce models, employment considerations, cultures, and regulatory requirements.

4. Reinvent Services for the AI era

Set a bold, practical vision for how AI changes the Services business, from how work is sold and scoped to how it is delivered, staffed, measured, and monetized.

Move beyond experimentation to demonstrate measurable results from AI through increased consultant leverage, faster implementations, greater consistency, improved customer experience, stronger knowledge reuse, and new Services delivery models.

Advance Cornerstone's evolution toward Services 2.0 through repeatable services, automation, outcome-oriented delivery, and new approaches to creating customer value.

We are looking for a leader who brings a genuine point of view to this work, experiments thoughtfully, learns quickly, and can be an internal and external thought leader on the future of AI-enabled Services.

5. Build the organization for what comes next

Develop a high-performing global leadership team and rapidly build the capabilities required for the future Services organization.

Create an environment that combines accountability with entrepreneurial energy. Develop talent in areas such as AI-enabled delivery, advisory services, commercial acumen, partner orchestration, outcome-based delivery, and new-product readiness.

Lead significant change with clarity, bringing people with them while maintaining strong customer and business performance.

Key leadership accountabilities

• Lead the global Services business across both Services Sales and Services Delivery.

• Build Services capabilities across both traditional SaaS delivery and AI-native solutions. These may require different delivery motions, talent, methodologies, and operating models, but they must come together as one connected, seamless customer experience from sales and implementation through adoption and value realization.

• Build the operating model, management systems, and global leadership alignment required to scale.

• Drive performance across bookings, revenue, margin, utilization, capacity, delivery quality, customer experience, and time-to-value.

• Create a more integrated customer journey by partnering with Sales, Product, Partners, Customer Success, Support, and Solutions.

• Scale delivery intentionally across internal teams, Global Delivery Centers, and Services partners.

• Define and execute an AI strategy for Services with measurable customer, productivity, and economic impact.

• Build a strong global leadership team and accelerate the capabilities needed for the future.

• Serve as an executive sponsor for strategic customers and a senior leader across the broader Customer Organization.

What Success Looks like...

Within the first 12 months, this leader will have:

• Created stronger global alignment around a clear Services strategy, operating model, performance agenda, and leadership expectations.

• Strengthened core operating fundamentals while maintaining strong customer and business performance through change.

• Demonstrably reduced friction and time-to-value across the customer implementation journey.

• Advanced a scalable global delivery model across Cornerstone teams, partners, and Global Delivery Centers.

• Put AI into production across meaningful Services workflows with measurable improvements in productivity, delivery speed, quality, or customer outcomes.

• Established a clear roadmap for the next generation of Cornerstone Services, including more repeatable, scalable, outcome-oriented, and AI-enabled delivery models.

• Built momentum behind the talent, leadership capabilities, and culture required to scale globally.
You have what it takes if you have...

• A proven builder/operator who has scaled and evolved a meaningful global Professional Services or technology Services organization, not simply inherited and managed a mature operating model.

• Enough scale experience to understand what great global operations require, combined with the hands-on instincts to build processes, capabilities, teams, and operating mechanisms where they do not yet exist.

• 10 + years of demonstrated leadership across both Services Sales and Services Delivery, with strong commercial and operational fluency.

• Experience leading globally distributed organizations and navigating the practical realities of operating across regions, including different cultures, labor environments, workforce models, and regulatory considerations.

• 10 + years of deep experience with partner-led delivery and blended models spanning internal teams, strategic partners, and Global Delivery Centers.

• A strong track record of improving customer time-to-value, experience, and measurable outcomes, not simply project economics.

• A genuine AI thought leader with demonstrated examples of using AI to materially change how a Services organization operates or delivers value.

• Strong cross-functional leadership with the ability to shape strategy and drive decisions across Sales, Product, Partners, and customer-facing organizations without relying on organizational authority alone.

• An energizing change leader who can create clarity from ambiguity, challenge established assumptions, make decisions, and build momentum across a complex global organization.

• A strategic thinker who stays close to the work, the customer, and the data and is equally comfortable defining the future state and building the mechanisms required to get there.

Ava Labs is redefining the way people create value with Web3. Join us as we empower people to easily and freely digitize all the world’s assets on one open, programmable blockchain platform.

Join the AvaCloud team at Ava Labs as a Senior Technical Product Manager. We've already empowered leading organizations like J.P. Morgan Kinexys, FIFE, and Nexon’s MapleStory to bring innovative products to market, and we're just getting started.

Ever since we started in 2007, Sunrun has been at the forefront of connecting people to the cleanest energy on Earth. It's why we've become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. Today, we're on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we're building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. And we're doing it by designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. We're unlike any other solar company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle - from sale through installation and beyond - so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

As a leader at Sunrun, you'll bring our leadership principles to life by creating the experience, leading by example, and communicating well & often. You'll keep score to drive results, develop people to help them grow, and build a deliberate culture where our values shine: We Love People, We Love to Create, and We Love to Run. Most importantly, you'll attract and retain top talent to help Sunrun build the best team on the planet. Together, we run.

This role will be a critical leader leading, designing and delivering a holistic, human-centered people strategy that attracts, retains, and engages world-class talent to drive Sunrun's mission. This individual will lead a high-performing team across all People Operations, Compensation, Benefits, and the Data & Analytics functions. As a key partner to the Executive Leadership Team, this role will own and evolve our total rewards philosophy and compensation-related interactions with the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors.

The ideal candidate has a strategic command of total rewards and people operations, coupled with executive compensation expertise, exceptional analytical rigor, and the ability to guide and influence stakeholders with confidence.

Total Rewards Strategy & Execution

  • Compensation: Drive the design, implementation, and administration of all compensation programs, including salary structures, incentive plans, and team member recognition. Lead the annual compensation cycle, including benchmarking, merit increases, and equity grants.
  • Executive Compensation & Board Engagement: Own the preparation of Compensation Committee materials and provide strategic counsel to the executive team and board on equity programs, pay-for-performance, and market competitiveness.
  • Benefits & Wellness: Lead the strategic design and administration of our benefits and wellbeing programs, ensuring they are competitive, inclusive, and supportive of a diverse employee population. Lead the annual open enrollment process and oversee vendor partnerships and compliance to optimize costs and the employee experience.

People Operations & Compliance

  • Operational Excellence: Lead and mentor the People Operations team to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement across all HR systems and processes
  • HRIS Optimization: Act as a key partner for HRIS system strategy and functionality, ensuring our technology supports the efficient execution of People Team initiatives.
  • Compliance & Governance: Partner with Legal and Finance to ensure full compliance with public company disclosure requirements, audits, and all federal, state, and local regulations governing compensation, benefits, and employment.

People Data & Analytics

  • Data-Driven Insights: Build and maintain robust people analytics to support transparency and data-driven decisions for leadership across all People functions.
  • Metrics & Reporting: Own key metrics and reporting to measure the effectiveness and ROI of our total rewards programs and overall people strategy.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in Total Rewards and People Operations, including executive compensation leadership in a publicly traded company.
  • Experience directly supporting Compensation Committees and engaging with board-level stakeholders.
  • Deep knowledge of compensation structures (base, bonus, equity), benefits programs, HRIS systems (e.g., Workday)
  • Familiarity with SEC regulations, proxy disclosure, and CD&A reporting.
  • Strong analytical, modeling, and communication skills, with the ability to distill complex data into actionable insights for both executives and employees.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant professional certifications (e.g., CCP, CBP) are highly preferred.
  • Proven ability to build relationships with stakeholders, and lead through influence in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

Amanda Frock (amanda.frock@sunrun.com)

DATA CENTER SPECIALIST (STARLINK)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. We are looking for detail oriented and high-energy specialist to help deploy and resolve hardware troubles around the world. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Augment, deploy, troubleshoot, and repair hardware at Starlink PoP colocation sites worldwide. 
  • Travel internationally and domestically to resolve hardware issues affecting Starlink user service and deploying new hardware to scale our worldwide network
  • Diagnose failures within fiber optic circuits and execute repairs to bring system back to full operation
  • Rack and stack router and server hardware on designated locations around the world
  • Install servers and upgrade/replace parts of the servers following MOPs
  • Investigate and resolve issues with onsite commercial network and routing hardware
  • Improve existing, and create new, training documentation for continuous improvement of team skills
  • Coordinate the shipment and logistics of equipment and parts to POP sites
  • Executing spare parts strategy to ensure availability and minimize downtime
  • Coordinate and perform data center site surveys for potential new POP sites
  • Perform wireless validation surveys for VIP events and Global market access support

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 2+ years of experience troubleshooting hardware or IT equipment in the IT or telecom industry

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong knowledge of standard computer skills: MS Office, Visio, and web applications
  • Meticulous attention to detail, standards, and documentation
  • Ability to read, understand, and follow MOPs
  • Experience working with fiber optics network: installation, test, troubleshooting, and repair; using fiber optic test equipment (OTDR, OLS, OPM, VFL)
  • Experience constructing IT/network racks (UPS, PDUs, cable management, servers, network devices)
  • Experience installing, activating, or troubleshooting CWDM and/or DWDM using standard fiber equipment and testers
  • A methodical approach to fixing problems and the ability to research solutions independently
  • Fluency in languages in addition to English
  • Training on SpaceX specific tools and processes will be provided
  • Eagerness to learn new technologies in a rapidly evolving work
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work in team environments 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to distinguish between different colors and possess manual dexterity to complete fine motor tasks
  • Ability to travel as required; travel will be approximately 75% of the time to US or international gateway sites
  • General physical fitness and the ability to lift up to 50 lbs. is required for some tasks
  • Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings and climbing hand over hand
  • Ability to work at elevated heights
  • Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain
  • Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

Pay range:         
Level 1: $34.00 - $40.00/hour     
Level 2: $38.00 - $45.00/hour     
Level 3: $42.00 - $51.00/hour     

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. About Genius AI

Genius AI is building technology to help local businesses run themselves. Genius AI products do the admin work that keeps practitioners from the work they love and the people they serve. From GlossGenius to Reception, its products work 24/7 on busywork like booking, marketing, client management, finances, staff and inventory management, and more.

Genius AI technology has saved businesses 106M in admin hours, earned them $2.0B in additional revenue, and facilitated more than 624M client touch points.

About the Role

Genius AI is building 0-to-1 AI products we expect to be a massive revenue driver, and this role sits at the center of that build. As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll be the technical anchor for our highest-innovation teams: setting architectural direction, validating options through proof-of-concepts, and turning ambitious initiatives into clear, buildable roadmaps. This is an IC role with real leadership weight, roughly 60% architecture, planning, and technical direction, 40% hands-on building. The person in this role will be a force multiplier: unblocking engineers before they know they're stuck, making the hardest technical calls so the team doesn't lose momentum, and setting a new standard for what great backend engineering looks like at Genius AI. You won't be maintaining systems someone else designed, you'll be raising the ceiling on what this team can build, and doing it in a way that makes everyone around you better in the process.

This role is remote in the Greater Toronto Area.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and own the technical direction of AI-powered products and 0-to-1 builds, weighing long-term trade-offs with precision and keeping a healthy backlog of forward-looking, build-ready work
  • Integrate AI models and LLMs into customer-facing products, not as experiments, but as production systems with real reliability and performance requirements
  • Shape how Genius AI builds with AI, your architectural decisions will define what's possible across the product for years
  • Write high-quality code and rapidly ship proof-of-concepts to validate architectural options and tackle the team's hardest technical challenges before they become blockers
  • Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to translate ambiguous business goals into well-architected initiatives with clear sequencing and minimal rework
  • Proactively identify and resolve systemic technical debt before it slows the team down, unblock engineers, raise the quality bar, and make the people around you disproportionately more effective

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a strong backend focus, and a track record of owning system design and architectural choices for high-scale or high-growth products
  • Already building with AI as a structural part of how you work, you've integrated LLMs into production systems, used AI tooling to accelerate your development workflow, and have a sharp point of view on where AI changes what's architecturally possible
  • Ship fast and course-correct, you're comfortable making architectural calls with incomplete information, iterating rapidly in production, and treating ambiguity as a feature of early-stage work, not a reason to slow down
  • Deep Kotlin expertise with strong intuitions about backend architecture, service design, and performance at scale (TypeScript experience is a plus)
  • Solid command of modern cloud infrastructure: AWS and Kubernetes, at the level of someone who can navigate it confidently without being a pure infra specialist
  • Natural collaborator who can align PMs, designers, and engineering teams around a shared technical vision and keep execution moving without friction
  • Exceptional communicator who can make complex architectural trade-offs legible to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

Benefits & Perks 

  • Competitive health & dental insurance options
  • Flexible PTO
  • Annual stipend for professional development and continued learning
  • High performers at 5 years receive a $5,000 bonus to use however you recharge best
  • Paid parental leave
  • Fertility and adoption benefits via Carrot
  • Local events - in-person gathering opportunities throughout the year for our distributed team
At GlossGenius, we celebrate our differences and are committed to creating a workplace where all employees feel supported and empowered to do their best work. We believe this benefits not only our employees but our product, customers, and community as well. GlossGenius is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer.

Personal Information: Notice at Collection for Employees and Applicants

Agency Submissions
If a resume or applicant is submitted to Genius AI by a third party without a signed search agreement in place, it will become the property of Genius AI and no fee will be paid, irrespective of whether the candidate is hired. 

Genius AI may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence and machine learning systems (AI Tools), to assist in evaluating applicants’ qualifications and fitness for the position. These AI Tools may be used alongside human review during one or more stages of the recruiting process, including application screening, skills assessments, and interviewing. No final hiring decision will be made solely by AI Tools without human oversight.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Account Executive, a pivotal member of our enterprise sales team, is dedicated to driving growth by acquiring new clients across the region. This role is solely focused on expanding our footprint in the retail space. Leveraging top-tier products and effective sales strategies, the Account Executive collaborates closely with Value Engineers, Business Development Representatives, and other cross-functional teams to identify and capture high-value new business opportunities.

The Role:

The primary objective is to build and expand market presence by capitalizing on untapped opportunities in the region. As an Account Executive specializing in new business sales, this role is integral to our strategy for expanding market share through targeted client acquisitions. Key responsibilities include

The work you’ll do:

  • Drive New Business: Identify and develop new opportunities within a defined territory, targeting enterprise accounts to secure new logos. 
  • Own the Sales Cycle: Manage the entire sales process—from prospecting and qualification to closing six-figure deals
  • Engage Strategic Stakeholders: Build relationships across multiple lines of business, engaging with C-level executives, operational leaders, and key decision-makers.
  • Deliver Tailored Solutions: Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and demonstrate how Celonis’ solutions can solve their strategic and operational challenges.
  • Showcase Value: Present use-case-specific pitches and demos, independently or in collaboration with Value Engineers, to highlight the measurable impact of Celonis solutions.
  • Collaborate with Partners: Work closely with Big 4 consulting firms, SaaS providers, and industry partners to enhance the value proposition for your prospects. 
  • Leverage Team Support: Partner with your virtual team, including business development representatives, pre- sales, customer success, marketing managers, and partner managers, to drive success.
  • This role will be expected to spend the majority of their time in the field meeting with clients

The qualifications you need:

  • Proven SaaS Sales Experience: A strong track record of success in enterprise SaaS sales, with a focus on securing new business and consistently achieving revenue targets. 
  • Expertise in Complex Sales: Experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles within large enterprise accounts.
  • Track record of selling enterprise-level software applications to C-level stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen with a solid understanding of business processes and KPIs (e.g. in Retail)
  • Strong Communication Skills: Exceptional presentation and storytelling abilities to confidently influence senior stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Collaborative Mindset: A team-oriented approach, leveraging internal and external resources to achieve shared goals. 

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

Total compensation package will include base salary + bonus/commission + equity + benefits (health, dental, life, 401k, and paid time off). Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and that the actual total compensation offer will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, applicant's qualifications, skills, experiences, and location.
The base salary range below is for the role in California, based on a Full Time Schedule.
$140,000—$165,000 USD

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. Ever since we started in 2007, Sunrun has been at the forefront of connecting people to the cleanest energy on Earth. It's why we've become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. Today, we're on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we're building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. And we're doing it by designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. We're unlike any other solar company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle - from sale through installation and beyond - so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

As a leader at Sunrun, you'll bring our leadership principles to life by creating the experience, leading by example, and communicating well & often. You'll keep score to drive results, develop people to help them grow, and build a deliberate culture where our values shine: We Love People, We Love to Create, and We Love to Run. Most importantly, you'll attract and retain top talent to help Sunrun build the best team on the planet. Together, we run.

Overview
This role is expected to be a key advisor to leaders in the organization enabling informed decision making, generating analysis and insight, championing the use of data to measure performance, and supporting the Project Management team in the planning and delivery of transformation initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of data analysts supporting the Customer Operations organization
  • Provide a vision for the team and facilitate the development of team members and data based capabilities within the organization
  • Advise leaders and supervisors on the development of "Metrics that Matter" to monitor and measure their performance
  • Support the Executive team through execution of research and analysis related to Customer Operations
  • Lead research activities for the Customer Operations business unit providing analysis and insight to drive strategic direction and improvement initiatives
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of Executive Dashboards and Management Reports to drive informed decision making
  • Work hand in hand with the Project Management team to define and measure success metrics for business transformation initiatives
  • Collaborate with IT, Strategy, and other business units to develop capabilities and shared metrics for the organization
  • Manage requests for data support and implement framework for prioritization
  • Advise organization on best practice methodologies for utilization of data in optimizing operational activities

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Business or other quantitative discipline
  • Minimum of 4 years experience in an analytical role performing data analysis analysis, reporting, insight generation, or other business value adding function
  • High level of comfort with quantitative concepts
  • Proficiency in relevant software languages and packages such as Python, R, SQL, Looker, GCP, or similar
  • Experience in designing and implementing executive and management dashboards with Looker, Tableau, Excel or other tools
  • Attention to detail and ability to analyze complex data delivering actionable insight
  • Ability to work independently as well as lead and participate in cross functional teams
  • Comfort with written and verbal communication of quantitative and qualitative information with executives
  • Ability to motivate and influence stakeholders to drive complex issues to resolution
  • A proven track record of data analytics and productivity improvements; ability to influence and drive change while building solid relationships with your internal clients and external vendors
  • Solid problem solving and process analysis skills to define quickly implementable solutions to immediate issues while enabling long term scalable solutions
  • Experience managing multiple simultaneous projects in a fast-paced environment with several stakeholders that deliver results
  • Experience in managing a team

Recruiter:
Tyrone Taylor (tyrone.taylor@sunrun.com)

About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Drive operational excellence and employee success as an HR Manager at our Lewisville Fulfillment Center.

 

The opportunity:

The People team is at the heart of Flexport's growth, ensuring we attract, develop, and retain the best talent to redefine global trade. As an Onsite Human Resources Manager, you will be the dedicated HR leader for our rapidly expanding Lewisville, Texas Fulfillment Center. This is a hands-on role where you will partner directly with FC leadership, managing all HR functions for a large, dynamic workforce. You'll be instrumental in shaping the employee experience, fostering a positive culture, and ensuring our operations run smoothly and compliantly.

 

You will:

  • Serve as the primary HR partner for the Lewisville Fulfillment Center, advising leadership on all people-related matters.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle for our workforce, including, onboarding, performance management, and offboarding.
  • Lead employee relations efforts, conducting investigations, mediating conflicts, and ensuring fair and consistent application of policies.
  • Drive HR program implementation at the site level, including performance reviews, compensation cycles, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local employment laws and Flexport policies within the fulfillment center.
  • Analyze HR data to identify trends, recommend solutions, and contribute to site-specific HR strategies.

 

You should have:

  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years in an onsite operational environment (e.g., fulfillment center, manufacturing, warehouse).
  • Proven expertise in employee relations, labor law compliance, and HR best practices for non-exempt workforces.
  • Strong ability to partner with and influence site leadership to achieve business and people objectives.
  • Experience managing HR functions independently for a specific site or business unit.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • A 'compliance first' attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

 

You will get:

  • The opportunity to be a critical HR leader in a fast-paced, high-growth global logistics environment.
  • A chance to build and shape HR practices within a key operational site.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • A culture that values diversity, inclusion, and continuous learning.
  • Work alongside a team of passionate, mission-driven individuals who are transforming global trade.

 

#LI-onsite

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences is seeking a dynamic candidate to fill the role of Sr. Research and Grants Manager to work under minimal supervision on all financial aspects of the Principal Investigators assigned to the work unit they support. This includes a large volume and diverse set of federal and non-federal sponsored research projects, involving multiple sub-awards, principal investigators, and/or cross-school initiatives.
The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at Stanford University School of Medicine places high importance on advancing science and integrating our mission with those of clinical innovation and service, educational excellence, community engagement and commitment, and professionalism and leadership development. This approach allows us to change future understanding and practices in our fields of science, the health professions, and society at large. It is an approach that stretches the traditional boundaries of an academic department and acknowledges the interdependent nature of the five missions with which we are entrusted. For us, the vision affirms the diverse activities, past successes, and distinct career paths of our multidisciplinary faculty. It establishes a mindset that will help draw our people together to collaborate and combine efforts that are necessary in moving forward this full academic portfolio. Finally, it is a vision that provides an authentic rationale for growth in a number of critical areas arising in fields from basic science to public policy.

Duties include:

• Obtain cost sharing commitment and support. Serve as liaison and active partner between principal investigators, Office of Sponsored Research, research groups, and other departments; respond to sponsor inquiries; advise of new regulations.
• Collaborate with Office of Sponsored Research to ensure awards are set up properly and cost-sharing requirements are fulfilled; initiate cost transfers.
• Review and approve expenditures, advise on post award spending and commitment activity, and oversee compliance related to fund and revenue.
• Develop and communicate reports supporting project status; create forecasting models, scenarios, and decision aides.
• Manage contract closeout process and audit inquiries; submit final reports and certificates.
• Interpret complex university and government policies (FAR, Cost Accounting Standards, Office of Management and Budget circulars, sponsored guidelines, etc.) for project and university personnel and help guide other staff in interpreting complex policies.
• Identify and implement process improvements. Participate in and lead cross campus projects. Train and advise on issues requiring specific technical expertise.
• Oversee and review work of other staff. May supervise, train and mentor other staff.
• Serve as a resource on subject area to principal investigator staff.


Other duties may also be assigned

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
• MA/MS/MBA

About TP

 

Teleperformance is a global, digital business services company. We deliver the most advanced, digitally powered business services to help the world’s best brands streamline their business in meaningful and sustainable ways.

With more than 500,000 inspired and passionate people speaking more than 300 languages, our global scale and local presence allow us to be a force of good in supporting our communities, our clients, and the environment.

  

Benefits of working with TP include:

  • Paid Training
  • Competitive Wages
  • Full Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k and more)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Employee wellness and engagement programs 

 

Teleperformance and You

 

Through a balanced high-tech and high-touch approach blended with deep industry and geographic expertise, we make people's lives simpler, faster, and safer. We help companies adapt quickly to changing needs, and are inspired to deliver only the best in all that we do. You will become a key contributor in making that happen.

  

As the eyes and ears for our team fielding customer inquiries and finding innovative ways to respond, you will work in a collaborative and engaging environment. You will have the chance to interact with people from all walks of life, and no two days will be the same. As you continue to grow and challenge yourself, you will discover your potential can take you anywhere you want to go.

 

Did you know that our Chief Client Officer started her career at Teleperformance as an agent and advanced to the pinnacle of the company? At Teleperformance, the sky is the limit!

 

At this time, Teleperformance can only offer employment to individuals located in the following states: AL, AR, AZ, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, MT, NC, ND, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WI, WV, WY

 

Use your own Device!

This position will allow you to use your own personal device (desktop, laptop or tablet). Devices must have Windows 10 or later, minimum of 4GB RAM, Etherenet LAN connection for Internet. So no need to head into an office, you can work in any quiet & confidential space of your home..what's better? a space AND system you're familiar with, WIN WIN!

 

Your Responsibilities

As a Customer Service Representative, your main responsibility is to find innovative ways to respond to varying questions, issues, and concerns. 

  • Connect with customers via phone/email/chat/video and/or social media to resolve their questions or concerns
  • Calmly attempt to resolve and de-escalate any issues
  • Escalate interactions when necessary and appropriate
  • Respond to requests for assistance and/or possible processing payments
  • Track all call related information for auditing and reporting purposes
  • Provide feedback on call issues
  • Upsell if required

We’re looking for fearless people – people who are inspired to deliver only the best in all that we do.

  • Ability to work remotely in a virtual team environment
  • 6 months Customer service experience preferred
  • Over 18 years of age
  • Ability to type 25 wpm
  • High School Graduate or GED
  • Comfort with desktop computer system
  • Proven oral & written communication skills
  • Logical problem-solving skills
  • Ability to navigate Windows operating systems
  • Organization and work prioritization skills

Work from Home Requirements:

  • Must be able to provide a personal device (desktop, laptop or tablet), with Windows 10 or later, Wired Ethernet LAN connection, Internet Connection (Satellite, wireless and dial-up ISP are not permitted), a minimum of 4GB RAM

  • Internet Requirements:

    • Minimum subscribed download rate equal or exceeds 15.0 Mbps
    • Minimum subscribed upload rate equal or exceeds 5.0 Mbps
    • ISP must have no packet loss and ping under 50ms
    • Internet connections cannot be Satellite, Mobile Data (5G, 4G, 3G hotspots), P2P or VPN 
    • Proof of internet speed required

Be Part of Our TP Family

It is our mission to always provide an environment where our employees feel valued, inspired, and supported, so that they can bring their best selves to work every day. We believe that when employees are happy and healthy, they are more productive, creative, and engaged. Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an established consulting leader—a current Big Four Director, Managing Director, or Partner-track Senior Manager—to spearhead our highest-stakes Oil & Gas engagements. In this executive-level role, you will serve as the principal strategic architect for our most valuable Upstream, Midstream, Downstream, and LNG accounts globally.

Leveraging the Celonis Process Intelligence platform, you will bridge the gap between macro energy transition strategies and modern cloud/AI execution models, moving clients from slide decks to realized operational value.

The Impact You’ll Make

C-Suite Advisory & Value Architecture

  • Peer-to-Peer Advisory: Partner directly with Oil & Gas C-suite executives (CEOs, COOs, CFOs, Chief Sustainability Officers) to align macro pressures—capital discipline, decarbonization, yield optimization, and supply chain volatility—with execution-level transformation roadmaps.
  • Map Enterprise Digital Twins: Oversee the deployment of the Celonis Process Intelligence Graph to build systemic, end-to-end operational models of complex oilfield, pipeline, or refining enterprises.
  • Orchestrate $100M+ Business Cases: Direct the formulation of board-ready Celonis Value Assessments, delivering the economic justification, working capital improvements, and OPEX returns required to greenlight massive cloud, IoT, and Edge AI investments.

Transformation Leadership & Ecosystem Governance

  • Steer Enterprise Transformations: Serve as the executive sponsor for high-visibility, Celonis-driven operating model overhauls for Fortune 500 O&G clients, guiding them from diagnostic discovery to closed-loop automation.
  • Architect Celonis Centers of Excellence (CoEs): Design and establish corporate-wide CoEs, defining the target operating models, governance structures, and enablement frameworks needed to embed data-driven decision-making into client cultures.
  • Untangle Systemic Friction: Lead cross-functional teams to resolve complex operational leakages where siloed O&G stacks (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, IBM Maximo, Hydrocarbon Accounting systems) collide—specifically optimizing mega-project capital procurement, asset turnaround management, and joint venture accounting.

Commercial Growth & Scaled Innovation

  • De-Risk High-Value Sales Cycles: Convert complex regulatory, environmental, and safety mandates (EPA, OSHA, BSEE, API standards) into automated, visual compliance audits within the Celonis platform, transforming abstract risk management into compelling business cases that accelerate C-suite sign-off.
  • Commercialize Next-Gen "Process + AI" Use Cases: Direct the integration of industrial telemetry (refinery IoT, pipeline SCADA, digital oilfield data) into Celonis, translating complex data structures into high-margin, executive-ready offerings like predictive asset integrity and real-time carbon intensity tracking.
  • Productize Oil & Gas Value Plays: Codify repeatable client successes into scalable Celonis apps and action templates, establishing a library of industry-specific intellectual property that drives rapid time-to-value, net-new ARR, and account expansion.

The Profile We Are Looking For

  • Consulting Pedigree: 12+ years of progressive experience within a Big Four or elite management consulting firm, currently operating at the Director, Managing Director, or Partner level.
  • O&G Vertical Expertise: Deep, authoritative knowledge of the Oil & Gas sector (Upstream exploration/production, Midstream logistics, Downstream refining/petrochemicals, or LNG), with a track record of leading multi-million-dollar transformation programs.
  • SaaS & Process Intelligence Vision: Strong conceptual understanding of Process Mining paradigms. Experience with Celonis is highly advantageous, but a proven ability to leverage enterprise software to reshape business processes is required.
  • Architectural Fluency: Comprehensive understanding of the modern enterprise stack (SAP, Oracle, Maximo) and emerging data/AI paradigms (Azure AI, LLMs). Note: You do not need to write code or SQL queries, but you must possess the technical fluency to direct data scientists, engineers, and solution architects.
  • Commercial Acumen: Proven capability in client origination, relationship management, and driving account growth through value-based selling.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Petroleum, Chemical, or Industrial preferred), Computer Science, or Information Systems. An MBA from a top-tier business school is highly preferred.

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

What you'll do

There is no MSSP and no tier-1 queue here. Detection & Response engineers own their detections end to end: you write them, you tune them, and your team is paged when they fire. The security team is spread across the globe with a follow-the-sun pager rotation so nobody is paged at 3am local.

The adversaries are real. The business is growing fast and the threat surface is growing with it. Defining the necessary telemetry is part of the job.

Detection engineering

  • Build and tune detections across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud, treating them as software: version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and shipped through the same CI/CD practices the rest of engineering uses.
  • Track detection quality as measured quantities: coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, precision, time-to-detect. We don’t build-and-forget here.

Response & automation

  • Own incident response: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective that turns the incident into a systemic fix.
  • Build automation that removes toil from investigations, and partner closely with the US-based team so context carries across time zones instead of getting lost at handoff.

Telemetry & partnership

  • Define telemetry requirements for new systems before they ship, working with infrastructure and product teams to close visibility gaps rather than discovering them during an incident.
  • Threat hunt proactively across the estate, converting hypotheses into either new detections or documented coverage.

You Should Have

  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with real hands-on time writing and tuning detections. We care more about what you've built than the exact number.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) and comfort writing production-grade detection and automation code.
  • Experience with a modern SIEM or detection pipeline (Panther, Elastic, Splunk, or similar). What matters is that you've shipped and tuned detection logic in production.
  • Practical incident response experience: you've led or played a major role in triaging and closing out real security incidents.

Nice to have

  • Experience treating detections as code with CI/CD, peer review, and staged rollout.
  • Experience defining telemetry contracts for systems before they ship, rather than retrofitting logging after an incident.
  • A track record of critically evaluating and verifying AI-assisted work - testing, source-checking, validation - rather than trusting agent output by default. If you haven’t already spotted the em dashes in this job description and already thought about where the hiring manager (hi!) has put hands on keyboard and compared that to where they let the LLM watermarks through, you might not be the right person for the job.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native and Kubernetes telemetry.
  • Experience with fraud or financial-crime detection patterns.

How we work

  • We're in the San Francisco office regularly to work through incidents and detection design in person.
  • We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs.
  • We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why this role is special

  • You own your detections end to end, no MSSP, no tier-1 queue, no handing your work to someone else to triage.
  • The consequences here are physical, not abstract: a containment decision can stop a customs filing or freight actually moving, which makes the stakes concrete in a way a SaaS control plane rarely is.
  • You'll inherit a real, established estate with legacy telemetry gaps to close, genuinely underexplored surface area, not a well-mined problem.

Where you'll work

This role is based in San Francisco, and we have a strong preference for candidates who are there or willing to relocate — we're deliberately building this team in one place. Relocation support is available for the right candidate.

Investing your time with Flexport means having immediate impact, all over the world. You're empowered to do what's best for everyone and trusted to make the right decisions when and where you need them. Join our collective of entrepreneurs and improve the world's experience in global trade.

#LI-Onsite

Within the range displayed, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and / or training. The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences is seeking a dynamic candidate to fill the role of Sr. Research and Grants Manager to work under minimal supervision on all financial aspects of the Principal Investigators assigned to the work unit they support. This includes a large volume and diverse set of federal and non-federal sponsored research projects, involving multiple sub-awards, principal investigators, and/or cross-school initiatives.
The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at Stanford University School of Medicine places high importance on advancing science and integrating our mission with those of clinical innovation and service, educational excellence, community engagement and commitment, and professionalism and leadership development. This approach allows us to change future understanding and practices in our fields of science, the health professions, and society at large. It is an approach that stretches the traditional boundaries of an academic department and acknowledges the interdependent nature of the five missions with which we are entrusted. For us, the vision affirms the diverse activities, past successes, and distinct career paths of our multidisciplinary faculty. It establishes a mindset that will help draw our people together to collaborate and combine efforts that are necessary in moving forward this full academic portfolio. Finally, it is a vision that provides an authentic rationale for growth in a number of critical areas arising in fields from basic science to public policy.

Duties include:

• Obtain cost sharing commitment and support. Serve as liaison and active partner between principal investigators, Office of Sponsored Research, research groups, and other departments; respond to sponsor inquiries; advise of new regulations.
• Collaborate with Office of Sponsored Research to ensure awards are set up properly and cost-sharing requirements are fulfilled; initiate cost transfers.
• Review and approve expenditures, advise on post award spending and commitment activity, and oversee compliance related to fund and revenue.
• Develop and communicate reports supporting project status; create forecasting models, scenarios, and decision aides.
• Manage contract closeout process and audit inquiries; submit final reports and certificates.
• Interpret complex university and government policies (FAR, Cost Accounting Standards, Office of Management and Budget circulars, sponsored guidelines, etc.) for project and university personnel and help guide other staff in interpreting complex policies.

Ever since we started in 2007, Sunrun has been at the forefront of connecting people to the cleanest energy on Earth. It's why we've become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. Today, we're on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we're building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. And we're doing it by designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. We're unlike any other solar company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle - from sale through installation and beyond - so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Affiliate Experience Professional to join our Affiliate Partner team supporting our partner network in Puerto Rico. This role collaborates closely with Account Staff to identify, investigate, manage, resolve, and communicate issues or concerns raised by Affiliate Partners, such as customer concerns, legal escalations, and compliance violations.

The Experience Professional plays a pivotal role in maintaining healthy relationships with our partners, preventing and resolving conflicts and promptly addressing partner escalations. By effectively managing escalations, this role contributes to the overall success of relationships and works to preserve partner and customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, investigate, and effectively resolve escalated issues or concerns raised by Affiliate Partners and customers, ensuring a swift and satisfactory resolution.
  • Collaborate closely with Account and Program Staff, providing regular updates on active escalations and ensuring all stakeholders are informed throughout the resolution process.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives to seek approval for conflict resolutions, ensuring alignment with company policies and strategies.
  • Work in support of Partner Pipeline Managers to resolve aging pipeline-related escalations, leveraging tools and resources to facilitate resolution management.
  • Coordinate with Sunrun's general escalation team(s) to address complex or high-priority issues requiring additional support.
  • Maintain a comprehensive tracking system to monitor historical escalations by type and volume, analyzing trends to proactively address recurring issues.
  • Create and manage service tickets related to escalations, ensuring accurate documentation and timely resolution.
  • Communicate final conflict resolutions effectively to Partner Leadership, ensuring transparency and satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English required.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in conflict resolution, partner or customer escalations management, or a similar capacity.
  • Proven experience in conflict resolution, partner/customer escalations management, or a similar role within a dynamic environment.
  • Proficiency in both Spanish and English (spoken and written) is essential.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to track and analyze escalations to identify trends and propose preventive measures.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented mindset, adept at managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative attitude and ability to work within a cross-functional team environment.

Physical Demands

  • Be able to remain in a seated position for more than 50 percent of the workday
  • Sufficient hand, arm, and finger dexterity to operate a computer keyboard and other office equipment
  • Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force and occasionally lift and or move up to 15 pounds
  • Have adequate visual and hearing acuity to follow instructions, operate office equipment and determine the accuracy of the work assigned
  • Ability to perform normal office duties
  • Ability to operate office equipment including computers and determine the accuracy of work

STARLINK GROWTH LEAD, US NORTHEAST

Starlink is a revolutionary satellite constellation delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world—bringing an unprecedented opportunity to significantly impact communities, businesses, and governments worldwide. In the United States, Starlink is rapidly expanding access to high-speed internet for rural, suburban, and underserved communities.

The Growth Team is seeking a Starlink Growth Lead to own consumer subscriber acquisition and growth across the US Northeast region. This role will be responsible for building and executing local growth strategies through local partnerships, sales, affiliates, field marketing, events, and other awareness/growth initiatives. This person will serve as Starlink’s on-the-ground growth owner for the region, accountable for scaling adoption and expanding broadband access to households and communities.

The ideal candidate is an execution-focused, highly motivated operator with experience in business development, partnerships, growth, and/or sales within consumer technology, telecommunications, or subscription-based services. This role requires strong hustle, creativity, and the ability to operate independently while building scalable growth engines for Starlink within the region.

This is a unique opportunity to own an entire regional market end-to-end and directly drive Starlink’s expansion.
